title: Releasing a Learned Policy: Every Check of Phase 38 Run Against One Job, and the First That Fails Named

artifact.note: the capstone of the learning-from-demonstrations phase: a job written as numbers (the spread of starts the policy must handle, the share it must succeed on, the largest share of steps the guard may hand over) and a learned policy written as its network, its guard and how it was trained; a check that it beats the straight line on new episodes (38-02), succeeds from the job's starts behind its guard (38-05, 38-07), hands over rarely, survives an input that is not a number, never commands past the car's limit, and comes out the same when trained again from the same seed (38-04), and says which requirement is the first to fail
